title: The measure of faith is revelation — fuller light demands fuller faith
source_text: XXVIII. Sed quanto plura Deus revelavit, & magis distincte, tanto pleniorem & magis distinctam fidem ab hominibus exegit. Quum vero parcior atque obscurior erat revelatio, ad pauciora quoque fides extendebatur. Nam mensura fidei est divina revelatio: neque ad salutem opus est plura nosse & credere, quam sint ea quae Deus revelavit.
pass_a_gloss: But the more things God revealed, and the more distinctly, the fuller and more distinct faith he required from men. But when revelation was scantier and more obscure, faith also was extended to fewer things. For the measure of faith is divine revelation: nor is there need for salvation to know and believe more things than those which God has revealed.
pass_b_english: The more God revealed, and the more distinctly, the fuller and more distinct faith he required of men.
When revelation was thinner and darker, faith reached fewer things as well. Divine revelation is the measure of faith: for salvation we need not know and believe more than God has revealed.

choices.why: Less revelation, not more sparing of people.
